🔐 You can learn 80% of cybersecurity concepts using just 5 tools
⚠️ Disclaimer: This content is shared strictly for educational & ethical cybersecurity awareness purposes only.
👨‍💻 If you want to understand how hackers think and how systems are protected, these tools are a must-know:
🛠️ 1️⃣ Nmap
Used for network scanning and reconnaissance — helps identify open ports, services, and IP details to understand system exposure.
🛠️ 2️⃣ Metasploit
A penetration-testing framework used by security professionals to test vulnerabilities and understand how exploits work.
🛠️ 3️⃣ Shodan
A powerful search engine that shows internet-connected devices like servers, cameras, and IoT — highlighting why security matters.
🛠️ 4️⃣ Hydra
Demonstrates how weak passwords can be attacked using brute-force techniques, helping organizations improve authentication.
🛠️ 5️⃣ John the Ripper
A password-auditing tool that shows how predictable passwords can be cracked — reinforcing strong password practices.
🚀 Learning these tools helps you move from curiosity → cybersecurity awareness → ethical hacking skills.
💬 Comment “tools + your country” to get a list of 100+ cybersecurity tools
👀 Follow @podus.app for more tech, hacking & security education.

NRI Cybersecurity student here. These kind of products are gimmicky and you really don’t need these kind of the ones things.
Things that actually work:
1) Use password manager generated passwords.
2) Change your passwords at-least once in 6 months
3) Use MFA wherever available.
4) Use SSO instead of passwords.
5) Do not connect to public WiFi. In emergency situations, if no other option is available, use VPN.
6) Do not share OTPs to strangers. 
7) Privacy is a myth.

أولًا: SIM Card Cloning (استنساخ شريحة SIM)
SIM Card Cloning يعني محاولة نسخ البيانات السرية الموجودة داخل شريحة SIM،
وأهمها مفاتيح التشفير التي تستخدمها الشبكة للتأكد من هوية المشترك.
كيف كان ممكن نظريًا؟
في الماضي البعيد جدًا:
بعض شرائح SIM القديمة كانت تستخدم خوارزميات ضعيفة
وكان بالإمكان، في ظروف مخبرية خاصة، استخراج مفاتيح التشفير
ثم إنشاء شريحة ثانية تتصرف كأنها الأصلية
لماذا هذا غير ممكن عمليًا اليوم؟
الشرائح الحديثة تستخدم وحدات آمنة (Secure Elements)
المفاتيح لا يمكن قراءتها أو استخراجها برمجيًا
حتى الوصول الفيزيائي للشريحة لا يكفي
الشبكات الحديثة تراقب أي سلوك غير طبيعي وتغلق الخط فورًا
الخلاصة:
SIM Card Cloning تقنيًا شبه مستحيل اليوم،
ولا يوجد تطبيق أو برنامج قادر على “نسخ SIM” عن بعد.
أي ادعاء بذلك هو خرافة أو احتيال.
ثانيًا: SIM Card Swapping (تبديل / نقل الشريحة)
SIM Card Swapping هو الهجوم الحقيقي والخطير المنتشر حاليًا.
وهنا المفارقة:
لا يوجد أي كسر تشفير…
ولا أي اختراق تقني للشريحة نفسها.
كيف يتم؟
المهاجم يستهدف شركة الاتصالات وليس الهاتف
يستخدم الهندسة الاجتماعية أو معلومات مسربة
يقنع الشركة بنقل رقم الضحية إلى شريحة جديدة يملكها
بمجرد نجاح العملية:
المكالمات تصل إلى المهاجم
رسائل SMS تصل إلى المهاجم
رموز التحقق (OTP) تصبح بيده
لماذا SIM Swapping خطير جدًا؟
لأن كثيرًا من الخدمات لا تزال تعتمد على:
رقم الهاتف
ورسائل SMS كوسيلة أساسية للتحقق من الهوية.
وهذا يعني:
السيطرة على الرقم = السيطرة على الحسابات
مثل:
واتساب
إنستغرام
البريد الإلكتروني
الحسابات البنكية في بعض الدول
لماذا لا يزال هذا الهجوم فعالًا حتى اليوم؟
البشر أضعف من التشفير
الإجراءات الإدارية أسهل من الاختراق التقني
بعض شركات الاتصالات تعتمد على تحقق ضعيف
والـ SMS ما زال يُستخدم كعامل أمان رئيسي
الفرق الجوهري بين النوعين
SIM Cloning:
محاولة تقنية لكسر الشريحة نفسها → غير عملي اليوم
SIM Swapping:
استغلال إداري/اجتماعي لنقل الرقم → فعّال وخطير

node.text: Bushra Ansari's husband Iqbal Hussain opens up about his journey to marrying her, revealing that he had always been friends with her sister Asma Abbas and got in touch through them. He shares that he had a preference for older women and, despite enjoying eight years of bachelorhood after his first marriage, he ultimately decided to pursue her for marriage. ❤️✨ #BushraAnsari #IqbalHussain (📸: @arydigital.tv)
Shakal sa hi psycho lagta ya banda thank God farah is saved
Well there are many men who like elderly women not young women as they are not that mature for them… I don’t understand what’s the problem… was she divorced before looking in to another proposal
Main kyun embarrass ho rahi rahi hun 🫣 suna hi nahi ja rha

A study published by jewish doctor says that there are some clothes that are actually lowering your body frequency while there are few fabrics that help you to attain more subconscious spirituality.
Clothes made up of Polyester, Lycra, Acrylic, BPA and PFAS contain 0 frequency and are harmful for both health and soul as per the study.
There is another list of clothes that are actually more healthy and operate at high frequency.
Here is the list of those cloth fabrics:

These fabrics are frequently cited for their high frequencies, often amplifying energy rather than draining it:Linen: Tops lists at 5,000 Hz (50x body frequency); derived from flax, it's healing, antibacterial, and used historically in priestly garments.

Wool: Around 1,000-5,000 Hz; strengthens the body, grounding, and naturally insulating.

Organic Cotton: Matches ~100 Hz (neutral/high); breathable, chemical-free, and grounding without depletion.

Hemp: High resonance (~100+ Hz); durable, sustainable, clears stagnant energy.

Silk (minimally processed): 10-10,000 Hz; luxurious, spiritually uplifting, though modern treatments may lower it.

Shoaib Malik faces sharp criticism from a Pakistani TV anchor during a recent discussion, and the clip is now making waves online.

The exchange has sparked debate across social media, with reactions pouring in from both sides.

#thefista

Nooo he was just trying to tell her k wo serious nahi hai wo bhi mazak hi kar raha hai first time ap mil rahin hain is liyay shayad apko nahi pata k main mazak kar raha hoon ya serious hoon  and she disrespected him and he was just being genuine 🙄
Is chori chamaar kontv par kisne betha diya 😂
Ye zarur Sania Mirza ki fan hagi ... 🤣

Nooo he was just trying to tell her k wo serious nahi hai wo bhi mazak hi kar raha hai first time ap mil rahin hain is liyay shayad apko nahi pata k main mazak kar raha hoon ya serious hoon  and she disrespected him and he was just being genuine 🙄

Taking views and creating trends on social media is very easy, but the consequences are real, and only the person going through it truly knows the pain behind it.

We have seen even the strongest personalities on social media face separation, and families being forced to take oaths on the Quran because of public pressure, even when they were men. I am just an ordinary girl on my own, with my own career, who worked extremely hard to build her life.

Initially, I gave a statement because I believed there might have been confusion or misunderstanding. I took action because I have always stood up for myself. The social media backlash has been very threatening, and yet my character and dignity continue to be questioned.

The situation escalated when journalists were engaged to target my character and discuss my personal life. My privacy was already limited, and people started recording me without my knowledge and circulating those videos without any concern. Even my family was targeted, and things went so out of control that it became impossible to manage. My sisters-in-laws were also targeted, while the same people speaking about “protecting homes” were openly trying to destroy one. Even my past was dug up, which does not define or matter today.

With the blessings of Allah and my family, I am married to Imad Wasim.

It is deeply hurtful when people try to protect themselves by blaming and targeting a single woman, but I trust in Allah’s wisdom above all. I did not date anyone. I got married through a proper proposal to a man who was previously married and later divorced.

This is my truth, and I am the one who has lived it.

If Allah reunites us with his children, with the consent of everyone involved, I will welcome them with an open heart. I will care for them, love them, and raise them with kindness, respect, and responsibility alongside him.

I sincerely request everyone not to drag this matter further or attach assumptions and sentiments to something they have not experienced themselves.

Your phone knows where you are because of 32 satellites you’ve never thought about.

I built a real-time GPS satellite tracker that visualizes every single one of them.

What it does:

- Tracks all 32 GPS satellites in real time using actual orbital mechanics (TLE data + SGP4 propagation)
- Shows which satellites are above your horizon, which ones your GPS module detects, and which are actively fixing your position
- Plug in a USB GPS module and watch it parse live NMEA data — satellite by satellite, signal by signal
- Color-coded: gray (below horizon), blue (visible), orange (detected), green (locked)
- Green connection lines show the exact signal paths from space to your position
- Space mode with 25+ markers — launch sites, space agencies, Schriever SFB Master Control, Apollo 11 landing site, Point Nemo spacecraft cemetery

The invisible made visible.

3 files. No backend. No API keys. Pure orbital math in the browser.

New article on Substack breaks down everything — the 48-year GPS constellation history, how trilateration works, why Einstein’s relativity is a GPS engineering problem, what TLE data is, how SGP4 propagation works, and how I built it.

https://github.com/Ringmast4r/GNSS

node.text:
Pakistan Stock Market is currently trading at attractive valuations and in my view this is one of the best accumulation zones for serious investors

Real wealth is built when you buy during fear not when you chase during hype

Whenever the market corrects I see it as an opportunity not a threat

The key is simple invest in fundamentally strong companies with solid earnings cash flows and long term growth potential

Do your research stay patient stay disciplined and most importantly do not panic

History shows that those who stay invested in quality businesses during downturns are the ones who create long term financial independence
Not going to buy till kse 100 in the range of 121 and 75k
What about those who have invested in stocks through mutual funds
How to buy. What's the least investment for stocks
Is it a good time to invest now? Or should we wait more?

@tarab.ali29_ I manage PKR 45 billion institutional equity portfolio of a FI, besides holding a CFA. People like you invest on najumi's dips not institutions. Moreover, there are different levels of resistance. The recent freefall is mainly because of Oil prices escalation, which has created a country risk. So, as long as your knowledge is limited, stay humble.
Not going to buy till kse 100 in the range of 121 and 75k

Acting busy for the aesthetic ✨

Outfit @fourandcostore 

#maincharacterenergy #alishachaudhary #fashionmodel

Your phone just connected to a cell tower. You didn’t choose which one. You have no idea if it’s real.

IMSI catchers — also called Stingrays — are fake cell towers that trick your phone into connecting to them. Law enforcement uses them. Intelligence agencies use them. And now anyone with $1,000 in SDR hardware can build one. Your IMSI, your IMEI, your exact location — captured in seconds. No warrant required in many documented cases.

I built TowerHunter — a pocket-sized Stingray detector that runs on a ClockworkPi DevTerm.

- Polls your cellular modem every 6 seconds for tower identity, signal metrics, and GPS position
- Cross-references every tower against OpenCellID’s crowdsourced database using Haversine distance calculations
- Detects 3 anomaly signatures: rapid tower switching (3+ changes in 60 seconds), unusual country codes, and abnormally strong signals (RSRP > -80 dBm)

Pure Python. Zero dependencies. No pip installs. Drop the script on any Linux device with a modem and GPS and it runs. SQLite database, daily CSV logs, and a live web dashboard on port 8888 — all from a device that fits in your jacket pocket.

600 data points per hour. Every tower logged. Every handoff recorded. Every anomaly flagged and geotagged.

You can’t defend against what you can’t see. Now you can see it.

Full technical writeup on Substack:
https://open.substack.com/pub/ringmast4r/p/i-built-a-cell-tower-hunter-that

Ever wondered how strategic decision-making works in real life? 🤔 From business deals to dating apps, Game Theory is everywhere — and it’s not just for mathematicians! 🎯

Welcome to Game Theory Simplified — your go-to guide for breaking down complex strategies into simple, real-world insights. 💡 Whether it's the Prisoner’s Dilemma, Nash Equilibrium, or the art of bluffing, we explain it all in plain English with examples you’ll actually care about.

Perfect for students, professionals, or anyone curious about the invisible rules guiding our choices. No heavy math, just smart thinking. 🧠

Master negotiation tactics, predict outcomes, and level up your critical thinking with strategies used by CEOs, athletes, and even politicians. 🏆

Follow along to make smarter moves in life, work, and play — because in the game of life, understanding the rules can change everything. 🔄

Three men in Algeria were intercepted after attempting one of the most bizarre border crossings in recent memory — by disguising themselves as sheep in an effort to reach Spain 🇪🇸🐑😅

According to local authorities, the trio reportedly covered themselves in cotton-like padding to mimic wool and altered their appearance in an attempt to blend in with livestock being transported through the region.

The plan began to unravel when officers noticed unusual movement among the animals and decided to inspect the vehicle more closely.

What they discovered quickly ended the attempt. The men were taken into custody, and the case drew attention for both its creativity and its risk.

Officials described the episode as a reminder of the extreme measures some individuals resort to in hopes of crossing into Europe, often driven by economic hardship or limited legal migration pathways.

While the incident sparked disbelief online, it also highlights the broader reality of migration pressures in parts of North Africa and the Mediterranean corridor. Behind the unusual disguise was a serious and complex issue — one that continues to challenge border authorities and policymakers alike.

They have stunning showrooms in H-13 Islamabad and Gulberg Islamabad - definitely go visit them.

You can also check their collections online at www.poshish.pk ✨

If one advisor is sitting in:
	•	Room A (understanding how Pakistan’s financial system works)
	•	AND Room B (helping design India’s market structure)

Then the risk isn’t intent
The risk is exposure to both sides’ critical information

And in finance/geopolitics, information = power

A global advisory firm working across multiple rival economies isn’t new. But when that overlap touches high-sensitivity systems like currency or capital markets, it naturally raises tougher questions around access, influence, and incentives.

Always understand who sits at the intersection of information.

Because markets don’t just move on data.
They move on who sees the data first.

Would you be comfortable with this level of overlap in critical systems?

node.text:
Season 1, Episode 1 (“Pilot”) of Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette (FX/Hulu, premiered February 2026):

The episode opens with a flash-forward to July 16, 1999, showing John F. Kennedy Jr. preparing for a flight with Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy and her sister amid personal tensions, before cutting back to 1992. It introduces John’s struggles under the Kennedy legacy pressure, his career doubts, and past relationship issues. Carolyn shines as a poised, independent publicist/sales executive at Calvin Klein. They meet through Calvin Klein at a charity event or party, sparking an instant but complicated connection, setting up their whirlwind romance against fame and privacy challenges.
The sexual tension in this scene though 😩❤️

node.text:
AI isn’t the threat. Complacency is.

The companies that survive won’t be the ones avoiding AI.
They’ll be the ones integrating it into hiring, strategy, operations and decision-making.

The professionals who stay relevant won’t be the ones resisting change. They’ll be the ones learning how to work with it.

The question isn’t “Will AI replace me?”
It’s: Am I evolving as fast as the market is?

At XecTech Recruitment, we’re already seeing it.
The strongest candidates aren’t just skilled, they’re AI aware, AI enabled and future focused.

Adapt. Learn. Lead.
Or someone else will.

Spot on “You’re not going to lose your job to AI.
You’re going to lose your job to someone who uses AI.”
— Jensen Huang. 

Clip originally shared by simplyyougrow (remixed with commentary).

#AI #FutureOfWork #TechCareers #Leadership #XecTechRecruitment

node.text:
A Chinese influencer is said to have lost 140,000 followers almost instantly after a beauty filter malfunctioned during a livestream, briefly revealing her natural appearance. However, the claim appears to stem from social media posts, and there is no verified evidence confirming that such a massive drop in followers actually occurred or even that the incident itself is authentic.

According to posts circulating on the internet, the influencer was streaming live when her beauty filter briefly switched off, revealing a woman with mature skin and a warm complexion. Within seconds, the filter returned, once again displaying a pale, smooth, small-faced version of her. The circulating clip lasts only a few seconds and captures the moment the filter glitches. The video is widely being shared with captions claiming she lost 140,000 followers after her "real face" was exposed.

node.text:
I built an AI agent that hacks for me with OpenClaw and Kali Linux. 

Imagine messaging your own personal AI assistant and saying:
> “Find open CCTV cameras near me.”
> “Run a vulnerability scan on this server.”

And it just executes the commands on a cloud Kali Linux server—while you sit back and sip coffee. ☕️

In my latest video, I broke down exactly how I built this using OpenClaw and Kali Linux. It’s not just a chatbot; it has full access to run tools like Nmap, Metasploit, and bypass bot detection.

Full step-by-step tutorial is live on my YouTube channel! 👇

🔗 Link in Bio to watch the full build. Or go to
YouTube.com/c/zsecurity

⚠️ Disclaimer: For educational purposes and authorized security testing only.

#OpenClaw #KaliLinux #CyberSecurity #EthicalHacking #ai

#🇯🇵Japan is transforming footsteps into electricity ⚡

PLEASE READ: This video demonstrates a principle in neuroscience called selective attention — the brain’s natural process of filtering and prioritizing information based on what it believes is relevant.

Some people WILL absolutely notice the yellow vase and other colors. This is normal. 

Brains differ in how broadly or narrowly they filter information. Factors such as attentional style, nervous system state, novelty sensitivity, creativity and individual differences can all influence what enters conscious awareness.

The instruction to focus on blue objects was not intended to deceive. It was used to illustrate how easily attention can be directed, and how that direction influences what the brain brings into the foreground.

This reflects an everyday process. 

Our brains are constantly filtering reality — not to mislead us, but to help us manage the overwhelming amount of sensory information we receive every second.

This video is an example of that process, not a test, diagnosis, or judgment of anyone’s perception.

If you know similar projects, share them in the comments — let’s turn this into a real knowledge base.

We post one powerful insight daily. Follow @wealthy.setup. Daily lessons for the new age of money.

The Internet Map – A cosmic map of the web, clustering websites into ideas, communities, and cultures. Surprisingly meditative.
https://internet-map.net/

Interactive History of Western Philosophy – A dense, interactive map of Western philosophy showing influences, conflicts, and the evolution of ideas across centuries.
https://www.denizcemonduygu.com/philo/browse/

Theories of Consciousness Explorer – An interactive landscape of 350+ theories of consciousness, mapping how science, philosophy, and metaphysics intersect.
https://loc.closertotruth.com/interactive

Historical Tech Tree – A massive visual tree tracing technologies, inventions, and discoveries from prehistory to the modern world.
https://www.historicaltechtree.com

Democracy in US Congress – A data-driven visualization tracking how “democracy” and its perceived threats appear in US congressional speech since 1880.
https://pudding.cool/2025/11/democracy/

Every Noise at Once – Music as a cultural map: thousands of genres visualized by sound, mood, and proximity. A true internet classic.
https://everynoise.com/

1 Pixel Wealth (Jeff Bezos) – A stark, scrollable visualization of Jeff Bezos’ wealth, pixel by pixel. Minimalist, political, and hard to ignore.
https://eattherichtextformat.github.io/1-pixel-wealth/
I'd love to know what app you use everyday - please let me know in the comments 👇

The minimum number of our prayers is five, spaced a few hours apart. What is being taught through this, and what is the true reality of prayer?
In a Hadith Qudsi, Surah Al-Fatiha is described as the prayer itself. The foundation of Salah is Al-Fatiha. And in this Al-Fatiha, when I ask Allah for guidance, do you know one of its purposes?
O Allah, now it is about to be Zuhr prayer. Between Zuhr and Asr, I will have to make many decisions—small and big. Should I look at this or not? Should I say this or not? Should I send this message or not? Should I talk to someone about this matter or not?
These decisions have to be made in every moment.
And for every one of those decisions, O Allah, what should You give me? Give me guidance.
Then what happens is that this feeling of sincerely asking for guidance dries up within a few hours. Then the time for Asr comes, and again what do I ask? Give me guidance, my Lord.
Now until Maghrib, in all the decisions I have to make, there will be guidance—there is hope for guidance, if it is asked from the heart.

Assalamu Alaikum. If anything I ever said hurt you or sounded disrespectful, I sincerely apologize from my heart. It was never my intention to cause pain. Please forgive me if I made any mistake. May Allah keep you happy and grant you peace. Remember this ummah in your prayers Allah Hafiz🤍

Think for a moment, Sadia… it is Ramadan, the last ten nights — the nights in which Laylatul Qadr can come. Imagine that on one of those blessed nights you are standing in prayer, asking Allah for forgiveness, while at the same time your videos are still running on people’s phones and spreading everywhere.
Don’t you feel even a little sadness or shame in your heart thinking about this? 😔
And think even further… one day we will all leave this world. Imagine if you are no longer in this world, yet your videos continue to spread and people keep watching them. While you are in your grave, those actions may still be counted.
When we stand in Salah we ask Allah for forgiveness, but what about those ongoing sins that continue even after us?
Sometimes the most sincere thing we can do for ourselves is to stop something that might keep harming our hereafter. May Allah guide all of us and forgive us.

node.text:
Most social anxiety is not a clinical disorder, it’s an evolutionary response mixed with an inferiority complex. For thousands of years, social rejection meant loss of safety, resources, and belonging. That’s why your nervous system still reacts to rejection like a threat to survival. But today, fear isn’t dangerous, it’s comparison. You assume others are better, richer, smarter, more confident… and that assumption freezes you.

This video breaks down the psychology of social anxiety, why understanding human psychology humanises people you put on a pedestal, and how learning exposes the cracks behind the confidence you admire. It also introduces the idea of a conscious alter ego, not pretending, not a disorder, but a real psychological tool to access confidence, assertiveness, or calm when needed. Social anxiety doesn’t disappear by force. It dissolves when you stop mythologising people, and start seeing them as human.

🎖️Dados Sintéticos em Visão Computacional

A escassez de dados rotulados de qualidade é um dos principais desafios em aplicações reais de Machine Learning, especialmente em áreas como defesa e bioimagem. 

Datasets reais são frequentemente limitados, desbalanceados e difíceis de obter por restrições operacionais e de custo.

A geração de dados sintéticos permite controlar variáveis como geometria, pose e iluminação, ampliando a diversidade do conjunto de dados e melhorando a generalização dos modelos. Essa abordagem complementa dados reais e viabiliza experimentos mais sistemáticos.

No contexto militar, datasets públicos com alvos reais, como sistemas de mísseis terra ar, são extremamente raros. Ambientes virtuais permitem criar cenários fisicamente plausíveis para treinar modelos de detecção mais robustos.

De forma análoga, na reconstrução 3D de foraminíferos, imagens sintéticas multivista com parâmetros conhecidos viabilizam inferência geométrica precisa. 

O Blender, com API em Python, gratuito e amplamente adotado na comunidade acadêmica, possibilita pipelines reprodutíveis para pesquisa em visão computacional.

1.  Every banks in India have their cyber security team and they are very much careful onboarding a single vendor. 
2.  Specialize units from Israel only handles incidents critical incident. This is a global trade companies reach to Google, Crowdstrike in case of global catastrophe. 

3.  These softwares usually deploys on the client side itself IT admins or security team have full break the glass access bypassing these cyberark like softwares processes.
3.  These cybersecurity softwares are very clear transparency when it comes to data privacy collection. 
They never collect business data and on premises deployments have 0 data sync with these software companies.

CERT IN is a govt body of Indian cybersecurity framework just like SEBI 
they create compliances and policies and guide these banks , big corps which have direct correlation to Country's Security reputation

From Trump tariffs to Macron glasses, from the historic Carney speech to whispers of a new world order — this is what power looks like in 2026.

At the WEF World Economic Forum in Davos 2026, Mark Carney, now Canada’s Prime Minister, delivered what many call the best speech ever — warning about the economy 2026, the future economy, and the fragile future of the world.

With Greenland, US politics, the IMF World Bank, and fears of a coming world economy crisis, this isn’t just theory.
For anyone majoring in economics and trying to survive in this economy, this is the real economic state of the world — where the global economy and history are being rewritten live.

Machiavelli represents a shallow understanding of power one that reduces it to obvious, cynical tactics and mistakes surface level harshness for depth, never reaching the deeper complexities that truly define how power works.
I would as Sunzi/Sunzu the Art of war
@jamshid_secular We’ve made a video about it on our YouTube Channel « The Eastern man who Inspired the West - Ibn Khladun » We are sure you will enjoy

Do you think Pakistan still produces voices like Asma Jahangir?Asma Jahangir stood against military dictatorships, religious extremism, and the misuse of law when doing so meant threats, arrests, and isolation. She defended political prisoners, minorities, women accused under discriminatory laws, and families of enforced disappearances at a time when silence was rewarded and dissent was punished.

She co founded Pakistan’s first all women law firm, challenged Hudood laws, openly criticized military rulers from Zia ul Haq to Musharraf, and served as the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights. She proved that the Constitution is not a document of convenience but a promise that must be defended even when the state itself violates it.

Asma Jahangir was labeled dangerous, unpatriotic, and disruptive. History later called her principled.
Today, voices like Imaan Mazari remind us that resistance did not begin in this decade. It survived decades.

Courage does not appear suddenly. It is inherited through struggle, paid for with consequences, and carried forward by those who refuse to be silent.

This is not one name.
This is a legacy.#politics #pakistan #history #instagram #law
Don’t compare asma jahangir with mazari

We don't support someone whose secularism hit against core Islamic principles but we've type of womens who can directly challenge these type of illogical, irrational and brutal ideological philosophical fallacies
Some people don’t just live, they make history.

node.text: Pakistan has been allocating huge sums of revenue to service its mounting public debt, with recent figures showing the government repaid Rs 3,654 billion (about Rs 3.65 trillion) in domestic debt ahead of schedule during the first seven months of FY2026, a record effort that reflects stronger fiscal management and improved economic stability. Officials told the National Assembly that this early repayment has helped lower outstanding liabilities to the State Bank of Pakistan and reduce short-term refinancing pressures, contributing to a slight decline in the country’s debt-to-GDP ratio from around 74 % to nearly 70 %. However, Pakistan’s total public debt remains extremely high — exceeding Rs 80 trillion by June 2025 — driven by both domestic and external borrowings, and continues to absorb a significant portion of the federal budget, limiting funds available for development and essential services. While debt management reforms and targeted repayments offer some fiscal relief, the overall debt burden and servicing demands remain a central economic challenge for Pakistan’s policymakers.

🤖 Build Your First AI Agent in Just 30 Minutes ⏱️

Think AI agents are complicated? Think again.

In this complete guide, I break down everything you need to create a functional research assistant that can:
✅ Search the web autonomously
✅ Analyze and synthesize information
✅ Make intelligent decisions
✅ Provide structured responses

No PhD required. No complex theory. Just practical, hands-on building.

What you'll learn:
→ Core agent architecture (LLM + Tools + Orchestrator)
→ Setting up LangChain & OpenAI
→ Creating custom tools for your agent
→ The ReAct reasoning loop explained
→ Production-ready code you can use today

Perfect for:
- Software engineers exploring AI
- Data scientists building GenAI products
- Developers wanting to add AI to their apps
- Anyone curious about autonomous agents

I built this guide specifically for beginners who want results fast. By the end, you'll have a working agent and understand how to customize it for your use case.

🔗 Full guide
A PDF Version of the complete Guide is shared with our Exclusive Instagram Subscribers 👑. Get access to it with 1000+ other FREE Resources for just Rs.45 per month❗️. Click subscribe button in profile to access it.

Already building agents? Drop your use case in the comments 👇

📲 Follow @datasciencebrain for Daily Notes 📝, Tips ⚙️ and Interview QA🏆

node.text: 5/7 FlockNova: Uncovering Hundreds of Data Points with a Single Identifier #privacy #tech #surveillance #cybersecurity #fyp
What about this new cloaked app service? Do you think that would help?

late response. companies build a profile on every single person to show them certain advertisements that they are the target audience for. the government also does this same exact thing except they say its to “prevent terrorism” (George Bush’s PAATRIOT act). sometimes the government will have certain companies share their user data with them. and then you have these data aggregators like FLOCK or Palantir who pull data from all these different sources.
@dav1smcl yup. I cover ad tech in some videos and before starting my own company built the infrastructure for some.

node.text:
To be magnetic, cultivate an irresistible presence by embodying wholeness from within—feeling complete without needing external validation—while radiating high-frequency emotions like joy and confidence through grounded posture, steady eye contact, and active presence. 

Walk into rooms with deliberate elegance, shoulders back and head high, to command space naturally; listen deeply without distraction, asking thoughtful questions that make others feel truly seen and valued, which draws them toward you effortlessly. Shed self-doubt by showing up as your highest self daily—evolving through self-awareness of habits, speaking intentionally without gossip or oversharing, and prioritizing inner stillness via short meditations or phone-free walks to maintain a calm, lighthouse-like energy that shifts any atmosphere and attracts opportunities, relationships, and abundance without force.

Las tres religiones principales se remontan a la veneración de Saturno. Saturno se percibe como la matriz que abarca el tiempo, el espacio y la materia, y actúa como la verdadera deidad de este mundo. Ejerce dominio sobre el reino físico, incluyendo el cuerpo y todos los aspectos materiales. La noción compartida de “cielo” o de un reino alternativo en todas las religiones refleja que la conciencia humana trasciende los confines de este mundo.

Judaísmo y Saturno

El término “sábado” tiene sus raíces en la palabra fenicia “shabba”, que significa Saturno. El sábado es el día de culto de los judíos. El sábado es el día de Saturno. Además, durante las oraciones judías, se observa que los fieles llevan el cubo negro de Saturno.

Cristiandad & Saturno

En Corintios 4:4, el pasaje menciona a “Satanás, que es el dios de este mundo” (no por ello es malo ni bueno). La interpretación postula que Satanás es sinónimo de Saturno. Este mundo es una simulación del reino de Saturno. Además, la cruz cristiana significa el cuerpo, la tierra y la materia; Jesús es el sol, el sol iluminando la tierra, la materia. Por esto los masones la llaman “cruz de muerte y destrucción, la cruz de cristo”.

El islam y Saturno

En el islam, los fieles veneran la Kaaba, una estructura con forma de cubo negro. La forma geométrica del cubo se asocia con la creación de la materia, donde el negro significa materia y el blanco simboliza espíritu. Esta conexión simbólica se establece con Saturno, considerado la deidad de la materia, y el cubo está situado en el polo norte de Saturno. Además, en los rituales islámicos, los individuos circunvalan el cubo, reflejando los anillos que rodean Saturno, estableciendo un paralelismo simbólico entre la circunvalación de la Kaaba y los anillos que rodean el planeta.

Desde esta perspectiva simbólica, Satanás no representa necesariamente el mal, sino una fuerza asociada a la materia, al límite y a la experiencia terrenal. Los únicos “malos” somos los seres humanos.

node.text:
Prayer is not meant to be rushed or empty.

It is meant to connect the heart to Allah.

When prayer becomes lazy, delayed, or only done for people to see, something slowly changes inside us.

Not all at once.

But little by little.

Lack of focus in prayer weakens the heart.

Delaying ṣalāh without reason makes us careless with time.

Neglecting Fajr and ʿIshā slowly distances us from discipline and remembrance.

Every believer struggles at some point.

But awareness is the first step back.

Fixing prayer does not start with perfection.

It starts with honesty.

With asking Allah to help us pray better, not just pray more.

Return to your salah before it becomes a habit done without meaning.
check your dms in sha allah

node.text:
I highly recommend making a map of your area if you’re hiking, camping or to throw in your bug out bag. 

❗️ Extra Tip: If you would like a larger size map or want to have it laminated, I generally use Staples. I make my map on the Caltopo website and then upload it to the Staples website where I can choose larger paper options and they’ll even laminate it…it’s usually under $5 and done the same day so that’s one of my go to’s. 
.
.
.
#map #emergencypreparedness #hiking #camping #bugoutbag

🎬 Unlock the internet’s hidden movie library! 🍿

Tired of endless subscriptions? Watch how I use advanced Google Dorks to find free movies in seconds, the smart way.

You don’t need coding skills. I updated my free tool, DorkSearch PRO, with a new feature: FILE_HUNTER mode. It does the hard work for you.

How to do it:
1. Go to the tool (Link in bio).
2. Switch to “FILE_HUNTER” mode.
3. Type the movie name.
4. BOOM! 💥 Direct access to open directories with the files you need.

Use it responsibly... 😉

⋆ ˚｡⋆୨୧˚  A bond of warmth & quiet understanding ˚୨୧⋆｡˚ ⋆On Jemima Khan’s birthday, remembering the gentle friendship she shared with
Princess Diana 🤍

In Diana’s final years, Jemima was more than a familiar presence she was a friend. Through shared moments, visits, and conversations,
Diana found comfort in the company of Jemima and Imran Khan, away from royal formality and public weight.

Their bond was rooted in empathy, kindness,
and a shared understanding of life under constant attention.
Jemima later spoke of Diana with deep affection,
remembering her not as an icon,
but as a warm, thoughtful, and deeply human soul.

The final frames are for Jemima herself, a quiet tribute on her birthday 🌷 to the woman who offered friendship, loyalty, and gentle companionship in Diana’s last year.

Happy birthday, Jemima Khan 🤍
A friendship remembered with grace and tenderness.

Rizq is not only about how much we earn.

It is about barakah in what we have.

We ask Allah for ease in income.

For halal provision.

For stability.

For growth without stress.

These duʿās remind us to turn to Allah first in our work, our business, and our daily efforts.

Because real provision comes from Him alone.

“Everything in the World is Free: Apps, Music, Books, Software—All at No Cost!” 
Imagine a world where apps, music, books, and software—whether for Mac or Windows—are all legally free. In this description, we’ll highlight trusted, open-source platforms that offer high-quality resources to everyone at no cost.

Sheikh Sulaiman Al Rajhi built one of the world’s largest Islamic banks, then gave nearly his entire $16 billion fortune away.

He chose education, healthcare, and poverty relief over luxury, while continuing to live simply himself.

His story proves that real legacy isn’t measured by what you accumulate, but by what you leave behind.

May Allah reward him in Abundance May Allah grant him the highest abode in Jannah fill his Qabar with Noor ND Make his Qabar Amongst the Gardens of Jannah and grant him Sadqatul Jariya in his Qabar Ameen ❤️

Allahu Akbar, such a rare soul are hard simply hard to find. May we be able to follow such a humble footsteps

✅ Multi-Source Correlation: Seamlessly merging unstructured and structured data streams.

✅ Automated Entity Tracking: Instant identification of organizations and individuals.
✅ Open-Source Intelligence: Bringing high-level surveillance capabilities to the public.
